tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, tables, panels, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: sidebar, table headers, inline code, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not meaning-bearing).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (checkbox, input, secondary button). 3:1 on surface-000 and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200 (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Pine — the Hub's identity. Primary buttons, links, active nav, focus ring. Text-safe on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav row, active tab ground, brand tint blocks. Put brand or ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-strong fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Mustard highlight — progress fill, 'key idea' marks, cover blocks. Never text on light surfaces; use accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the accent family (Tip labels) on surface-000/100 and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of Tip callouts and key-idea highlights.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Passed / success state (teal, off the red–green axis). Always paired with the word 'Pass' or a ✓ glyph.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of pass badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failed / risk state (vermilion). Always paired with the word 'Fail' or 'Risk' or a ✕ glyph.

tokens.name: fail-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of fail badges and Risk callouts.

tokens.name: flaky
tokens.usage: Flaky / retried / warning state. Always paired with the word 'Flaky' or '~'.

tokens.name: flaky-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of flaky badges.

tokens.name: skip
tokens.usage: Skipped / not-run state, with the word 'Skip'.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and code block ground in both themes.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, prompts ($) and file-tree guides on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: Commands, keywords and folder names on code-bg.

tokens.name: code-str
tokens.usage: Strings, flags and file names on code-bg.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hub hero title only, once per page. 38/42px under 900px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Automation does not replace testing expertise.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badge text, nav group labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, commands, inline code, file trees.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding-y.

tokens.name: space-1h
tokens.usage: Dense stacks only: option lists, nav rows, chip padding-y. The one deliberate half-step on the 4px scale.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding-x, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding-y, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, page gutter on phones, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a module.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between modules and around the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inline code, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, callouts, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bars and filter chips.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover shadows and border changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Drawer slide (mobile nav).

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Flashcard flip, the only 3D motion. All motion is removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky exam bar.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile navigation drawer.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip link when focused.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar collapses to a top bar and drawer; grids go single-column. Media queries cannot read custom properties, so this value is written literally in CSS.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone layout: stat tiles stack, card padding drops to space-4. Written literally in CSS.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered topic cards and the flashcard only. Everything else stays flat on hairlines.
